data.name: CheckBoxFFTTotal.ToolTip
data.value:
This setting is used to tell the software to analyze the FFT spectrum using a special technique to detect the total thickness of a multi-layer stack. Rather than picking the tallest peak, the software will pick the peak that appears at the thickest thickness which also satisfies the Min. Peak Height criteria.
This setting only applies when the Film Stack has a single layer.

data.name: TBNFFTScalingFactor.ToolTip
data.value: Scale the measured spectrum thin film interference signal amplitude by this factor in order to obtain a better match to the theoretical (calculated) spectrum. If the measured spectrum has a lower amplitude signal than is predicted by the film stack layers, the GOF will be reduced unless a scaling factor greater than 1 is set.

data.name: MaxIterationsBox.ToolTip
data.value: Convergence toward a solution proceeds until the number of iterations entered here is reached or until convergence is detected. Analysis time will be approximately proportional to the value entered here. (Typical value = 400)
